newsitem.title: UK: BOE GIVES UK MONEY MARKET 202 MLN STG FURTHER HELP.
newsitem.headline: BOE GIVES UK MONEY MARKET 202 MLN STG FURTHER HELP.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 202 million stg of assistance at established interest rates.
It allotted 12 million stg in bills outright and 190 million in repos to August 26 and 27.

The Bank has now provided liquidity totalling 1.35 billion stg on Tuesday, exactly matching its forecast money market shortage. It said no use has been made so far of the discount house late repo facility.
